calls.title: Is the Rally Real? 5 Stocks to Buy Now Before Election Day
calls.thesis: Rebound from managerial missteps; resilient consumer spending, regaining share + strong holiday season expected; to outperform retail peers
calls.base_case: Outperforms retail sector stock returns over next few months
calls.bull_case: Analyst sentiment rebounding, supporting the stock
calls.bear_case: Trades near consensus target; retail sector headwinds on discretionary

calls.thesis: Management reinvigorated growth (+5.3% sales, +4% traffic, margins recovering) but forward PE has soared 8 -> 16.7; reiterates his Aug-21 downgrade to hold.
calls.bull: Operating margins return toward historical 8% and premium-price strategy sustains top-line growth.
calls.bear: DCF fair value $93 vs ~$160 implies considerable downside; would only buy on a much bigger pullback.
